node.label: Reduced tissue phosphomannose isomerase activity
node.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme phosphomannose isomerase (PMI; EC 5.3.1.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.

evidence.snippet: Congenital disorder of glycosylation, type Ib: Reduced tissue phosphomannose isomerase activity (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
